verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's self-hosted proxy documents virtual keys that control model access and track spend per key, user, and team. Keys can be created with or without a team_id, and the vendor frames this as putting the whole AI stack 'behind one key', so callers use gateway keys rather than provider credentials. One community user mentioned unspecified 'issues with creating tokens for other users'; that is too vague to dispute the capability but lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that provider credentials stay hidden from virtual-key holders, detailed key-minting API/UI steps for team- and app-scoped keys, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can mint gateway-managed keys for teams and apps without exposing raw provider keys
